title: Rubik's Uncubed
description:
Our last big project at Magmic, an official Rubik's Cube themed sliding match 3 style game that we all had fun building and were very proud of, which we dubbed Rubik's Uncubed.

![](/assets/projects/career/rubik-s-uncubed/screenshot-2.webp)![](/assets/projects/career/rubik-s-uncubed/screenshot-1.webp)

I got to exercise some graphics programming muscles here, building fun visual effects for all the different abilities and mechanics.

![](/assets/projects/career/rubik-s-uncubed/screenshot-3.webp)![](/assets/projects/career/rubik-s-uncubed/screenshot-4.webp)![](/assets/projects/career/rubik-s-uncubed/screenshot-5.webp)

Prior to the start of this project, me and another dev were tasked with building a new version of the actual Rubik's Cube mobile app, which was lots of fun to program on its own, including different sizes and patterns of cube, and a solver that would give you instructions to solve actual physical cubes.

![](/assets/projects/career/rubik-s-uncubed/screenshot-6.webp)![](/assets/projects/career/rubik-s-uncubed/screenshot-7.webp)
